title: As Dubai crude breaches $80, DBCC yet to decide on fuel excise tax–Palace
summary: The Development Budget Coordination Committee (DBCC) has yet to recommend to President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. whether to suspend or reduce the fuel excise tax.
